title: Amplification program transition function
statement: For natural numbers $cS$ and $F$ and a Boolean $os$, the program with 15 registers, four deciders, and labels parameterized by $cS$ and $F$ is defined by the transitions in the formal statement: its labels specify deterministic register operations, branches, and calls, as well as a choice between two destinations at the sampling label; at the terminal labels it returns true or false, with the transition at the final decision label determined by $os$.
caveat: The definition is a large label-by-label transition table; a compact prose description cannot specify every register operation, branch, call, and destination exactly.
